en: Sepia postcard showing a small wooden house by the shoreline and a stone pier with people in early 20th‑century clothing. Caption at the top reads "Lilla Ångbåtsbryggan, Gustafsberg, Uddevalla." The reverse has Swedish handwriting, is labeled "Brevkort / CARTE-POSTALE," and bears a red Swedish 10 öre stamp with an early 1910s postmark. Addressed to Fröken Elie Bergman in Kristianstad.
